t.TOCOPHEROL.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule. In food it appears as E307.
t.TOCOPHEROL.eff.0: In the EU there is no health warning or usage limit specific to this substance. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.TOCOPHEROL.what: Protects the product and its oils from oxidation; also used as a skin conditioning agent.
